sections.title: What Sonus is
paragraphs: Sonus is an independent educational resource dedicated to In-Ear Monitors (IEMs). It brings together clear explanations of technical concepts, carefully organized product information, and practical comparison tools in one place. The site is designed for both newcomers who are just discovering the world of IEMs and experienced listeners who want a clean, focused way to explore and compare models.
Sonus is not a store. It does not sell products, process payments, or take commissions. It exists purely as a reference and learning platform.

sections.title: Why it was created
paragraphs: Getting started with IEMs can feel overwhelming. Specifications are scattered across manufacturer sites, review language is often inconsistent, and it is difficult to understand what terms like “soundstage,” “sibilance,” or “hybrid driver” actually mean in practice. Many people buy their first pairs without a clear sense of what to expect or how different models compare.

Sonus was created to lower that barrier. It aims to explain the fundamentals in plain language, present product information in a consistent format, and give users tools to compare tuning and specifications side by side. The goal is to help people make more informed decisions and enjoy the hobby with greater confidence.

sections.title: What you can do on Sonus
paragraphs: All product information is compiled and presented for educational purposes. Prices, specifications, and availability can change; users should always verify details with official sources or retailers before making a purchase.
bullets: Learn core concepts through a structured glossary covering hardware, frequency ranges, tuning styles, and performance terms.
Browse a curated showroom of IEMs with consistent specifications, materials, and personal insights.
Compare models side by side, including frequency response graphs when measurement data is available.
Adjust language, currency display, and theme preferences for a more comfortable experience.

sections.title: Our goal
paragraphs: Sonus aims to be a calm, reliable, and transparent starting point for anyone interested in IEMs. We want to make technical information more approachable, reduce the noise of marketing language, and support a more thoughtful approach to exploring personal audio. The site will continue to grow with additional educational content, refined product data, and improved comparison tools while remaining independent and free of commercial pressure.

sections.title: 1. Nature of the Service
paragraphs: Sonus is an informational and educational website. It provides general information about In-Ear Monitors, related technical concepts, and selected product data. The content is offered for personal, non-commercial use only.

sections.title: 2. No Professional Advice or Sales
paragraphs: Nothing on Sonus constitutes professional advice, a recommendation to purchase, or an endorsement of any product. Specs, prices, ratings, and insights are approximate, compiled from publicly available sources, and may contain errors or become outdated. Ratings and written insights reflect the personal opinion of the site creator and should not be treated as objective measurements or expert certifications.
Users are solely responsible for verifying any information with official manufacturers, authorized retailers, or independent measurements before making purchasing decisions.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual Property and Images
paragraphs: Product names, brand names, logos, and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners. Sonus does not claim ownership of, or affiliation with, any manufacturer or brand.

Product images displayed on the site are derived from publicly available official product photography. These images have been edited solely for presentation consistency on this website (for example, background removal or cropping). All rights to the original images remain with the respective copyright holders. Diagrams used on educational pages are sourced from Wikimedia Commons and credited accordingly.
If you are a rights holder and believe any content should be credited differently or removed, please contact the creator. Reasonable requests will be handled promptly.

sections.title: 4. Frequency Response Measurements
paragraphs: Frequency response graphs are provided for educational comparison only. Measurements are credited to their original sources. Graphs produced on different measurement rigs, with different equipment, or under different conditions are not directly comparable. Sonus makes no claim that any graph is definitive or laboratory-grade.

sections.title: 5. No Affiliation
paragraphs: Sonus is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or connected to any IEM manufacturer, distributor, or retailer. The site does not sell products and does not receive compensation for featuring or ranking any item.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Sonus and its creator disclaim all warranties, express or implied, regarding the accuracy, completeness, or usefulness of the information provided. In no event shall the creator be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of, or reliance on, the content of this website.

sections.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: These Terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms. The current version will always be available on this page.

sections.title: 8. Contact
paragraphs: For questions regarding these Terms, copyright concerns, or removal requests, please contact the site creator through the contact method provided on the website.

privacy.title: プライバシーポリシー

sections.title: 1. Summary
paragraphs: Sonus does not collect personal information. There are no user accounts, registration forms, newsletters, or tracking systems that identify individual visitors. The site is designed to function with minimal data processing.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of the Website
paragraphs: Sonus exists to share knowledge about In-Ear Monitors. It is intended for people who are new to the hobby as well as those who already have experience and simply want a clean way to browse and compare information without visiting commercial storefronts.

sections.title: 3. Information Stored on Your Device
paragraphs: Certain preferences are saved locally on your own device so the site can remember your choices between visits. These may include:
bullets: Items added to the comparison list
sections.tailParagraph: This information is stored using browser local storage and, where necessary, a small preference cookie. It remains on your device and is not transmitted to the site operator or any third party.

sections.title: 4. No Tracking or Analytics of Individuals
paragraphs: Sonus does not use advertising networks, does not sell or share data, and does not employ tracking technologies that profile individual users. Any aggregate, non-identifying technical data that may be generated by normal web server operation (such as standard access logs) is used only for basic site maintenance and security.

sections.title: 5. Third Parties
paragraphs: Sonus does not integrate third-party advertising, social media tracking pixels, or marketing tools. External links may lead to manufacturer or retailer websites; those sites have their own privacy practices for which Sonus is not responsible.

sections.title: 6. Children’s Privacy
paragraphs: The site is not directed at children under 13. Because no personal information is collected, no additional parental consent mechanisms are required.

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated if the site’s functionality changes. Any significant changes will be reflected on this page. Continued use of the site after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.title: 8. Contact
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how the site handles information, please contact the creator through the method provided on the website.
